title: Differentiation of Hematopoietic Progenitor Cells from Human Pluripotent Stem Cells
author: Mo, Qu, et al.

steps.title: Thaw Essential 8 supplement
steps.instruction: Thaw one vial (10 mL) of Essential 8 supplement at 4 °C for at least 12 hours.

steps.title: Prepare E8 medium
steps.instruction: Add the thawed Essential 8 supplement to 500 mL of Essential 8 basal medium, aliquot the mixture into 50 mL centrifuge tubes, filter each aliquot through a 0.22 µm filter, and store the filtered E8 medium at 4 °C.

steps.title: Thaw Matrigel
steps.instruction: Thaw one vial of Matrigel (5 mL) at 4 °C for at least 12 hours.

steps.title: Make Matrigel‑E8 aliquots
steps.instruction: Mix 5 mL of thawed Matrigel with 10 mL of pre‑chilled E8 medium, aliquot 1 mL of this mixture into pre‑chilled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, and store the tubes at –20 °C (yields 15 tubes).

steps.title: Coat plates with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Place one 1 mL Matrigel‑E8 aliquot on ice, dilute it with 29 mL of pre‑chilled E8 medium, and use 1 mL of the resulting solution to coat each well of five 6‑well plates (1 mL per well). Antibiotics may be added to the E8 medium if desired.

steps.title: Incubate coated plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the Matrigel‑coated plates at +20 °C for at least 30 minutes. After incubation, plates can be used immediately or stored at 4 °C for up to one week (if stored, equilibrate to +20 °C for ≥30 min before use).

steps.title: Equilibrate media and plates
steps.instruction: Before use, equilibrate both the Matrigel‑coated plates and the E8 medium to +20 °C for 30 minutes.
